terminal_reason.zh: strong model 只提 boundary candidate，environment/program verifier 给真值，delta debugging 删除到 1-minimal，再做一次 frozen agent update 与 independent boundary eval。
terminal_reason.en: A strong model only proposes boundary candidates, environment/program verifier supplies truth, delta debugging reduces them to 1-minimality, then one frozen agent update is evaluated on an independent boundary set.

pre_p0_gate.zh: 冻结 verifier、minimality procedure、final training-token budget 与 independent boundary set。
pre_p0_gate.en: Freeze the verifier, minimality procedure, final training-token budget, and independent boundary set.

strongest_baseline.zh: 同一 verifier-filtered counterexamples，不做 minimization，最终 training token 严格匹配。
strongest_baseline.en: The same verifier-filtered counterexamples without minimization, with final training tokens strictly matched.

minimum_p0.zh: 1-minimal curriculum 做一次冻结更新，与 token-matched non-minimal curriculum 比 unseen boundary generalization。
minimum_p0.en: Perform one frozen update with the 1-minimal curriculum and compare unseen-boundary generalization against the token-matched non-minimal curriculum.

exact_stop.zh: non-minimal baseline 等效，或 minimality 只省 token 不提高 unseen boundary generalization，则 DROP。
exact_stop.en: DROP if the non-minimal baseline is equivalent or minimality only saves tokens without improving unseen-boundary generalization.

terminal_reason.zh: 当前自动 curriculum 场景不够成熟。
terminal_reason.en: The current automatic-curriculum setting is not mature enough.

terminal_reason.zh: 与 D-2 共用尚未成熟的自动课程前提，本轮不作为 active Idea。
terminal_reason.en: Shares D-2's immature automatic-curriculum premise and is not an active idea this cycle.

exact_stop.zh: 随 D-2 当前周期停止。
exact_stop.en: Stops with D-2 for the current cycle.
